cs.label: Read-only
cs.reason: The quote is File Explorer's own "Read-only" checkbox in the file's Properties, which Czech Windows labels „Jen pro čtení“ (Microsoft termbase: read-only → jen pro čtení). Cmdr's `errors.listing.readOnly.title` is Apple's `Jen ke čtení`, a different app's word.
